verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the search configuration page, which mentions "product and version search filters". That implies the platform has a notion of per-product and per-version content, but there is no direct documentation of publishing versioned docs or of a reader-facing version switcher. missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring versions (e.g. in docs.json navigation), evidence of a site-side version switcher for readers, per-API-version publishing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
